data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Aqawa' which means 'to be wise, to be intelligent'. In Islamic tradition, Aqwal is considered a name that signifies wisdom and knowledge. The name Aqwal carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aqwal usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqwal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
